note: Step 19 ear poof color options (Nick 2026-10-20: make the poof darker gray so the round head does not look like it has a protrusion). Color only, through the coat shader's own strand attributes: fur_tone multiplies the strand color (linear = value^2.2 of the stated share of the head white), cupm mixes the ear stripe blue. Step 20 (Nick 2026-10-20: 'Maybe do a blue color ... or do an ombre') adds P-ice and P-ombre; cupm is stored per point from step 20 so a strand can fade along its length.
